items.prompt:
Repaint input 1 into a finished rough hand-painted anime martial game-card illustration, ECHO ARROW / 回音箭. Input 1 locks the diagonal isolated arrow and dark deep slate-blue background. Input 2 is STYLE ONLY: broad opaque directional paint planes, economical edges and selective focal detail, not the red palette or vertical pose.
The NAI draft has omitted the essential ECHO ARCS. ADD THEM CLEARLY as the second major visual shape: EXACTLY TWO LARGE interrupted cyan-blue elliptical wavefronts encircle the arrow shaft near its midpoint, their planes perpendicular to the arrow flight axis. They are visibly curved open crescents with gaps, not complete solid rings or tiny sparks. The nearer inner arc is brighter turquoise/ivory, compact and thick enough to read at thumbnail size; the farther outer arc is wider, slightly softer muted blue, fading along its broken ends. Each wavefront sweeps across BOTH sides of the shaft with perspective and a gap/occlusion at the crossing, conveying sound rippling outward and returning through air. Together the arcs occupy the middle half of the image, clearly visible against the dark backdrop. They must not disappear into faint background lines. Let their rhythmic repeated curvature express echo, never add extra arrows or musical symbols.

Keep one coherent silver-headed arrow aligned from upper right toward lower left, matching the target draft's shaft direction and foreground point. Correct the double-ended metal needle into an actual arrow: one sharp clean silver arrowhead at lower-left, one straight narrow dark shaft, two grouped blue-gray feather vanes at upper-right tail, with a small nock. The arrow remains clearly readable through the arcs, and the tip has a restrained ivory glint. Generous empty space remains in the upper-left and lower-right corners. Only arrow + TWO distinct echo arcs + quiet dark backdrop. No leaves, target, bow, humans, debris, particle cloud, dense ornament, landscape or scenery.

STYLE: rough hand-painted anime illustration built from large connected opaque color masses, a few wide directional swipes and blunt dabs. Arrowhead two decisive cold silver light/shadow planes, shaft a few elongated strokes, fletching two coherent masses without fine barbs. Echo arcs are broad curved painterly strokes with a lit inner edge, muted blue outer plane, expressive handmade tapers and selectively broken dry endings; luminosity is concentrated and restrained rather than glossy neon tubing. Detail hierarchy: clear arrow silhouette and large echo rhythm, selective impact-free edges, secondary materials quiet. Muted slate/gray and concentrated cyan. Preserve calm regions between paint marks. Avoid full traced outline, mesh, tiny facets, fine engraving, glossy 3D, photoreal chrome, smooth airbrush and all-over grain/canvas filters. No text, watermark, frame or UI. The two cyan echo arcs are REQUIRED and prominent.
